name: Grade 8 IIIT Practice: October Week 8 - Micro:bit Setup
description: Practice words for Grade 8 third-trimester app, Python, and Micro:bit work.

words.definition: A tool that helps Scratch connect to devices.
words.example: Scratch Link connected Scratch to the Micro:bit.

words.definition: A wireless way for nearby devices to communicate.
words.example: Bluetooth allowed the computer and Micro:bit to communicate.

words.definition: A small computer board used for coding projects.
words.example: The Micro:bit sent tilt data to the Scratch game.

words.definition: A sensor that detects tilt or movement.
words.example: The accelerometer detected when the board tilted left.

words.definition: The left-right direction in a coordinate system.
words.example: The x-axis value changed when the board moved sideways.

words.definition: The up-down direction in a coordinate system.
words.example: The y-axis value changed when the board moved up and down.

words.definition: A character or object in Scratch.
words.example: The sprite moved when the Micro:bit tilted.
